episode_summary: In this episode, Kevin McCarthy discusses the integration of AI in real estate websites, emphasizing the importance of unique content for SEO and AI optimization. He introduces Real Geeks' AI Connect, a tool that automates content creation, making it easier for agents to improve their online visibility. The conversation highlights the shift back to focusing on website content as a key strategy for lead generation and agent discovery.
